lines.text: Many learners say: Because I was tired, so I went to bed.
Better: Because I was tired, I went to bed.
Use because or so, not both.
We stayed home! Because it was raining, we stayed home.

data.wrong: Because I was tired, so I went to bed.
data.right: Because I was tired, I went to bed.
data.why: Use because or so, not both.

native.caption: คุณเคยพูดว่า “Because I was tired, so I went to bed.” ไหม? 😅 ภาษาไทยพูดว่า “เพราะ… ก็เลย…” ได้ แต่ภาษาอังกฤษใช้ because หรือ so เพียงคำเดียว: “Because I was tired, I went to bed.” ฟังครู Ama แล้วพูดตามนะ! ฝึกเพิ่มในแอป Lexkite

en.tip: Thai says “because … so …”, but English uses only one linking word
en.caption: Do you say “Because I was tired, so I went to bed”? 😅 Thai can use both words together, but English uses because or so, not both. Say “Because I was tired, I went to bed”! Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
